summary.text: Cole Hefner is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 5 who has represented the district since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Cole Hefner was born in Pittsburg, Texas.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner.
Hefner's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Ways & Means, Calendars and Public Education.
